projectForm.continuousHint: No deadline. The project goes on.

reasons.continuous_has_no_end: A continuous project has no target end date.

2026-10-23-118.title: Continuous projects
2026-10-23-118.body: Some projects never end, such as an internal tool or a retainer. Turn on “Continuous project” in New Project or Edit project. The project then shows “Continuous” in place of “No deadline”. A stage end date never makes it Late.
